description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'CustomProductGroupsController' responsible for managing custom product groups within an administrative web interface. It includes request mappings for listing, paging, saving, editing, activating/deactivating, and deleting product groups, as well as managing group details such as adding/removing products to/from groups. The class interacts with various service layers for category, product, and relationship management and provides JSON responses for AJAX calls.

classes.name: CustomProductGroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing custom product groups for admin interface, providing CRUD operations and group detail management.

methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new product group, with validation for duplicate codes.
